name: infra-guard
description: Guards infra work from Claude Code: shows the ambient kube/gcloud/gh/aws/argocd targets, requires named contexts and approved terraform/OpenTofu/terragrunt plans, reads scripts before they run, keeps Secret values from the model, logs changes and watches rollouts.

prodPattern.title: Production pattern
prodPattern.description: Regular expression; a target name that matches is shown as production

allowHelmGet.title: Allow helm get
allowHelmGet.description: Let `helm get values`, `helm get manifest` and `helm get all` run. Turn it on where chart values hold no credentials; rendered Secrets in a manifest are still printed
